def dt_format_to_regex(fmt):
    """Return a regex pattern that matches a datetime string formatted according to C strftime format `fmt`."""
    mapping = {
        '%Y': r'\\d{4}',
        '%y': r'\\d{2}',
        '%m': r'\\d{2}',
        '%b': r'[A-Za-z]{3}',
        '%B': r'[A-Za-z]+',
        '%d': r'\\d{2}',
        '%e': r'\\d{1,2}',
        '%H': r'\\d{2}',
        '%I': r'\\d{2}',
        '%p': r'[AP]M',
        '%M': r'\\d{2}',
        '%S': r'\\d{2}',
        '%f': r'\\d{6}',
        '%z': r'([+-]\\d{4}|[+-]\\d{2}:\\d{2})',
        '%Z': r'[A-Za-z]+',
        '%%': r'%',
    }
    regex = ''
    i = 0
    length = len(fmt)
    while i < length:
        if fmt[i] == '%':
            if i+1 < length:
                code = fmt[i:i+2]
                if code in mapping:
                    regex += mapping[code]
                    i += 2
                    continue
                else:
                    regex += re.escape(code)
                    i += 2
                    continue
            else:
                regex += re.escape('%')
                i += 1
        else:
            regex += re.escape(fmt[i])
            i += 1
    return regex
